playbook_title: Reality Truth — Content Creation & Topic Discovery Playbook
core_philosophy: Har mushkil chemical ya physics ke niyam ko rasoi aur rozmarra ki zindagi ke example se samjhana, taaki bina science padha insaan bhi 2 minute mein poora sach samajh sake.
writing_rules: No Textbook Jargon: Koi bhi heavy shabd (jaise 'Oxidation', 'Emulsifier', 'Oligodynamic', 'Maltodextrin') seedhe na chhodein—turant uska 'aam_bhasha_mein' matlab aur ghar ka example dein (jaise lohe pe zang lagna, tel-paani mein sabun dalna, ya chini ko tawe pe jalana).
Brand-Safe & Evergreen: Kisi ek brand par hamla karne ke bajaye process aur science samjhayein (example ke liye case ka zikr karein). Isse content hamesha upyogi aur kanooni taur par safe rehta hai.
Actionable Verification: Har topic mein kam se kam 2 aise tarike zaroor hon jo koi bhi ghar mein ya dukaan par 30 second mein check kar sake.
Balanced Fear-Free Tone: Darane ke bajaye sach batayein—jaise turant asar vs lambe samay ka risk alag-alag batayein.

topic_discovery_filters.filter_name: 1. Packet Front vs Back (Claim vs Chemistry)
topic_discovery_filters.question_to_ask: Packet ke aage bada daawa kya likha hai, aur peeche ke chhote Ingredients mein top 3 cheezein kya hain?
example_ideas: Immunity Booster / Health Drink (Asal mein Sugar + Maltodextrin)
Multigrain / Brown Bread (Asal mein Maida + INS 150 Burnt Sugar Colour)
Herbal / Natural Cream (Asal mein hidden Steroid / Paraben)

topic_discovery_filters.filter_name: 2. Heat, Cold & Time Change (Rasoi ke Reactions)
topic_discovery_filters.question_to_ask: Garam karne, fridge mein rakhne ya khatti cheez milane par ismein kya badlav aata hai?
example_ideas: Baar-baar garam kiya hua tel (TPC & Aldehydes)
Aluminium ya Copper mein nimbu/tamatar (Acid leaching)
Bahar rakha paka chawal (Fried Rice Syndrome)
Dhoop mein chhodi plastic water bottle

topic_discovery_filters.filter_name: 3. Too Cheap / Too Shiny / Too Long Shelf Life
topic_discovery_filters.question_to_ask: Ye cheez itni sasti, itni chamakdaar ya bina kharab hue itne mahine kaise tik rahi hai?
example_ideas: Neon peeli Haldi (Lead Chromate / Metanil Yellow)
1 saal tak chalne wala packed paratha / cake (Preservatives & Emulsifiers)

sources_to_track: FSSAI Press Releases, Food Alerts & DART Book (Adulteration Home Tests)
CDSCO Monthly NSQ (Not of Standard Quality) Drug List
BIS Care App & Quality Alerts (Gold HUID, Electronics, Helmets)
ICMR-NIN Dietary Guidelines & Consumer Voice Lab Reports
CERT-In / RBI Sachet (Digital & Financial Fraud Patterns)
